title: Schockanrufe in russischer Sprache – hohe Schadenssummen in sehr kurzer Zeit

extraction.summaryEn: Fraudsters posing as relatives and police made phone calls targeting Russian-speaking elderly residents, with about 20 cases and roughly 400,000 euros in losses in Berlin since January. In the example case, an 84-year-old in Spandau handed over cash to a courier after a fake traffic-accident bail scam.
